title: The Principles of the Book
summary: Work through The Principles of the Book.

blocks.md: This lesson follows **The Principles of the Book** in *Conclusion* (Vol III).

blocks.source: Vol III, Conclusion, § The Principles of the Book
blocks.md: Across Parts I through VI, each invariant was derived in the subsystem that owns it, and a later section collects all fifteen in one reference organized by the three H·S·A exposures, pairing each principle with its governing equation or structural contract and the design consequence it predicts. Part I prices an isolated model call and states the statistical limits of verification.

points: You have worked through The Principles of the Book.
